project.name: bot-pilot-connectors
project.description:
Top-level aggregator for all connector families (calendar, messenger, etc.).
Each connector family gets its own shared SPI module (containing the generic port interfaces and domain model that all concrete connectors must satisfy) plus one sub-aggregator per concrete integration (e.g. Google Calendar, Outlook).
This two-level grouping means: - Adding Outlook Calendar = add bot-pilot-outlook-calendar-connector here - Adding Slack connector = add a bot-pilot-connectors-messenger-spi + bot-pilot-slack-connector here Neither change touches the parent POM or any existing module.
